project_info.theme: 24-hour restaurant availability shown as a glowing fries nightlight
project_info.color_palette: Deep navy, warm golden yellow, dark brown, white, and red

main_subject.detail: A McDonald's-style fries carton converted into a plug-in nightlight; glowing golden fries emit warm light from a wall outlet.
main_subject.style: Minimal conceptual advertising, tactile product photography, polished poster art

composition_elements.type: Product prop, logo lockup, and sparse type
items: Center: fries carton plugged into a wall outlet, its fries acting as the luminous bulb.
Upper center: glowing golden arches symbol with tiny white 'open 24 hours' directly below.
Bottom right: small approved brand logo lockup.
Bottom center: tiny 'Underwood Dessert.' credit line.
Background: dark navy painted wall with a circular warm-yellow pool of reflected light.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: Warm practical glow against a dark room
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Golden halo, subtle wall texture, soft shadows, high contrast, calm nighttime mood

assets.name: Authorized McDonald's marks
assets.usage: Use arches above the product and logo lockup at lower right only when authorized.

assets.name: Approved fries packaging reference
assets.usage: Match carton silhouette and packaging material.

assets.name: Nightlight poster layout
assets.usage: Match outlet placement, symbol hierarchy, and small-print locations.

prompt_instructions: Use brand marks only with approval; otherwise replace consistently with a fictional restaurant identity.
Keep the fries-as-light metaphor physically readable and do not add unrelated objects.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: The creative poster features a box of fries transformed into a nightlight in the center. The golden fries act as light, reflecting off the wall behind the outlet and casting a yellow glow on the McDonald's logo. Below the logo, the words 'open 24 hours' are displayed in tiny white print, directly announcing McDonald's 24-hour operation with its most recognizable element. The bottom right corner displays the McDonald's logo, and at the bottom center, in tiny print, is the word 'Underwood Dessert.'
prompt.negative_prompt: daylight, cluttered scene, extra food, illegible text, distorted fries, broken outlet, harsh flash, watermark, signature
